status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만) · 복원 사업으로 풀어놓은 무리가 텃새로 지냄

months.note: 적은 수가 겨울에 날아오며, 인공 증식 후 방사한 개체 가운데 일부는 연중 관찰된다.

summary: 적은 수가 겨울에 찾아오는 매우 드문 겨울철새로, 논, 하천, 호수에서 어류, 개구리, 들쥐 따위를 잡아먹는다. 예전에는 전국에서 번식하는 텃새이자 겨울철새였으나, 지금은 야생 개체가 국내에서 번식하지 않고 천수만, 해남, 제주도, 순천만, 낙동강 하구 등지에 겨울에 날아온다. 최근 인공 증식으로 방사한 개체가 충남 일부 지역에서 번식한 기록이 있고, 그 가운데 일부는 연중 국내에서 보인다. 세계적으로는 시베리아, 연해주 남부, 중국 동북부에 분포한다.

points.en: pale yellow iris and red skin around the eye

art.subject: Oriental Stork (Ciconia boyciana), adult as seen in Korean winter farmland (plumage the same all year): head, neck, body, tail and wing coverts pure white, with long loose white feathers forming a shaggy ruff on the lower foreneck; primaries and secondaries black, so the folded wing shows a black rear half to the body. Massive, straight, dagger-shaped black bill; pale whitish-yellow iris set in a ring of bare red skin that runs forward to the lores; long red legs.
art.pose: walking slowly through a harvested paddy, hunting for fish and frogs
art.scene: Korean winter farmland: harvested rice paddies and a shallow stream near a broad estuary; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing upright in a field: white body and neck with a shaggy white ruff on the foreneck, black flight feathers forming the rear of the folded wing, massive straight black bill, long red legs
adult, head detail: pale whitish-yellow iris in a ring of bare red skin extending to the lores, massive dagger-shaped black bill, smooth white head without crest
adult in flight seen from below: neck stretched forward and red legs trailing, white body, wing coverts and tail, all primaries and secondaries black forming a broad black rear half to each wing
art.build: Huge white stork, about 112cm long, taller and much bulkier than a Grey Heron. Long neck held straight, not kinked; rounded head without any crest. Bill very long (much longer than the head), deep at the base, straight and sharply pointed, entirely black. Legs very long and red. The folded black flight feathers cover the rear of the body and reach about the tail tip; tail short, square and white. In flight neck stretched straight forward and legs trailing beyond the tail; long, broad wings with deeply fingered black tips.
avoid: Do not paint a red or orange bill and a dark eye — that is White Stork (Ciconia ciconia); this species has a black bill and a pale eye.
Do not fold the neck back into an S-curve in flight like a heron.
Do not paint black wing coverts or a black back; only the flight feathers are black.
Do not paint pink or grey legs, or any crest or plumes on the head.
